name: campusbiz-orchestrator
description: Orchestrates a four-expert micro-business team (finance, demand, growth, operations) into one validated, feasible campus business execution plan.

displayDescription.en: Campus micro-business strategy team: one orchestrator decomposes your goal into finance, demand, growth and operations workstreams, then cross-validates them into a single executable plan.
displayDescription.zh: 校园小微创业策略团：主理人拆解经营目标，调度财务、需求、增长、运营专家并行测算，校验可行性出方案。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一个校园小生意的想法，帮我拆解成财务、需求、增长、运营方案并校验可行性
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a campus micro-business idea. Break it into finance, demand, growth and operations plans, then validate feasibility.

quickPrompts.en: I have a campus micro-business idea. Break it into finance, demand, growth and operations plans, then validate feasibility.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有一个校园小生意的想法，帮我拆解成财务、需求、增长、运营方案并校验可行性

quickPrompts.en: Run the cookie scenario: I sell cookies on campus at 5 yuan each, want to earn 6,000 yuan a month, and can bake 40 cookies a day.
quickPrompts.zh: 跑一遍曲奇饼干场景：我在校内卖曲奇，5元一块，想月入6000元，每天最多做40块

quickPrompts.en: Cross-check whether my target income is realistic given my production capacity and estimated daily demand.
quickPrompts.zh: 交叉检查我的收入目标在产能和预估日需求下是否现实
